description: Reads one paper's citation impact from OpenAlex and the open citation sources Frontier uses: citations, field-weighted citation impact (FWCI: its citations against papers of the same field, year and type, where 1.0 is the world average), its citation percentile in its field, whether it is in its field's top 10% or top 1%, and whether it is retracted or carries a correction or an expression of concern. Works for any paper, not only those in Frontier's index. Accepts a DOI (or a doi.org link), an OpenAlex work id, a PubMed id (pmid:123), or a title.

paper.description: A DOI, doi.org link, OpenAlex work id (W123...), pmid:<id>, or the paper's title.

name: check_paper
title: Check any paper's citation impact
